setup_filter: setup a 2D FIR filter tensor with normalization, flipping, and gain scaling for upfirdn2d
upfirdn2d: pad, upsample, filter, and downsample a batch of 2D images in a single fused operation
filter2d: filter a batch of 2D images using a 2D FIR filter with automatic padding
upsample2d: upsample a batch of 2D images using a 2D FIR filter with configurable upsampling factor
downsample2d: downsample a batch of 2D images using a 2D FIR filter with configurable downsampling factor
